status: PREPARED - UNAPPROVED. Not runnable: no APPROVED.json; no Groq limits documented
purpose: Smallest live check of the frozen Pass 1 path before the other 23 targets
subset_of: runs/p1-v1f-gemini-20261124 phase 1 (15 apps). Frozen plan NOT modified; this is a separate selection.
selection_rationale: mixed categories (messaging, ads, e-commerce, SEO, dev platform); 3 original-Notion + 2 reconstructed-provenance; all phase-1 apps have sufficient cached evidence (tier A). Selection is for operational coverage, not for expected accuracy and not a random sample.
model: gemini-2.5-flash ONLY (3.5 temporarily unavailable; 3.6 not introduced)

call_budget.expected_basis: 1 call/app x 87/75 observed-estimate retry ratio, rounded up
call_budget.why_8: 40% of the 20 RPD planning ceiling; leaves >=12 for later because today's remaining quota is unknown; each retry counts

pacing.basis: 5 RPM -> 12 s + 1 s margin; dashboard already shows a 6/5 RPM peak

checkpoints: one pass1/<id>.json per app, written atomically and read-only; existing outputs never overwritten
append-only request log + STOPPED.json with per-model counts
after app 1 and after app 5: operator review of quote_found rate, schema validity, request_attempts before any further call
hash index of outputs after the run
stop_conditions: first 429 containing 'per day' -> stop whole run, no retry, no rotation
any 429 'rate' twice in a row -> stop (RPM breach)
2 consecutive 503/5xx on different apps -> stop, no fallback to another model
any schema-invalid or quote-verification-failure on app 1 -> pause for review
any unexpected model name in a response -> stop
Groq not involved in this pilot
runner_gaps_found: frozen runner v6 has NO inter-request pacing (only retry back-off 15/30 s) -> could breach 5 RPM
no stop on consecutive 5xx (it continues to the next app)
no hard stop on repeated rate 429 beyond 3 tries/app

it reads the subset from APPROVED.phases / plan.ids only: a 5-app subset needs its own PLAN.json in a new run dir with the identical runner copy; adding pacing/stop rules = new runner v7, which needs your approval and a new FROZEN.json
